component.name: SMART Disk Analyzer
component.summary: Read every SMART parameter of your disks and forecast their remaining life

description.p: SMART Disk Analyzer reads the self-monitoring data every modern drive keeps about itself and turns it into a health score and a remaining-life estimate.

ul.li: every ATA attribute, NVMe health-log field and SCSI counter, searchable and sortable
a health score with the risk factors that produced it
a remaining-life forecast combining wear trend, write budget, defect growth and design life
the partition layout of each drive, including unallocated space
trend charts built from snapshots stored on this machine

description.p: Reading SMART needs raw device access, so the application asks for authentication once through PolicyKit and then serves its dashboard on 127.0.0.1 only.

screenshot.caption: Health score, remaining life and the partition layout of the selected drive
Every SMART parameter in one filterable table

description.p: First packaged release: per-disk volume map, file-manager links, dimmed palette.
